name: Node Wiring Test
author: pgianotto
description: Pick an FPP model and step or auto-chase through it one node at a time, using FPP's own channel-test API, to visually verify wiring order against what each node's position is supposed to be. Built to catch miswired/reversed/crossed pixel strings before a show runs.

privacy.summary: Runs on this device only. Lights one node at a time on a model you pick by calling FPP's own local channel-test API (POST /api/fppd/testing); nothing is sent off this device.
privacy.other: Temporarily overrides live output on the selected model's channels while a test is running/stepping, the same way FPP's built-in Channel Output Test page does. Stopping the test (or leaving the page) clears the override; nothing is written to config or persisted.
